capabilities.title: Acting outside this application
capabilities.description: Booking an appointment, sending an email or a message, or doing something in another system on the user’s behalf. This assistant works inside this application only.
capabilities.refusal: I can take you anywhere in this application and explain what you find there, but I can’t book appointments, send messages or act in another system for you.
examples: book a physio appointment for my son
send an email to the coach about this
schedule a doctor’s visit for this injury
marca uma consulta para o meu filho

capabilities.title: Changing records for you
capabilities.description: Creating, editing or deleting a record. This assistant takes the user to the screen where they can do it themselves; it never fills a form or saves a change on their behalf.
capabilities.refusal: I can take you to the right screen and tell you what to do there, but I don’t create, change or delete records myself.
examples: change the date on this for me
fill in this form for me
altera a data disto por mim

capabilities.title: Questions about anything else
capabilities.description: General knowledge, other software, or any subject this application does not cover. The assistant answers about this application and nothing else.
capabilities.refusal: I only know this application — I can’t help with things outside it.
